q: The Abramov-Rokhlin formula expresses the entropy of a skew product T̃(x,y) = (Tx, φ(x,y)) over (X,μ,T) with fiber maps φ(x,·) preserving measures ν_x as:
exp: Abramov-Rokhlin: h(T̃) = h(T) + ∫_X h(φ(x,·)) dμ(x). The entropy of a skew product is the base entropy plus the fiberwise entropy (averaged over the base). This generalises the product formula h(T×S) = h(T) + h(S).
